intent_summary: Qualifying assessments are grouped by event time and entity into cases with explanations, evidence references, and numerical severity.

criteria.criterion: Evidence for different declared entities remains in separate cases even at the same event time.
Criteria met in multiple source datasets can raise numerical severity and identify the contributing sources.
A derived relationship adds context without counting as an additional independent source for severity.
Adaptive location-shift rules can create an early grouped case without a point trigger, using only evidence available at detection.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected conversion case contributors, explanation, evidence references and investigation questions; correlated source/derived support is grouped without adding a source vote.
